name: @3dcad-horeca/desktop
description: 3DCadHo.Re.Ca come app desktop (Electron) per Mac, Windows e Linux
author: Jacopo Donà

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --format cjs --external electron --outfile dist/main.js
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run stage && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && bun run stage && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && bun run stage && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build && bun run stage && electron-builder --linux
